title: Make a Sorted Copy
description: Return a sorted copy of the values without changing the original list.

mutates_input: The caller may need the original ordering after this function.
Compare the list before and after the operation.
Sorting in place and producing a sorted result are different behaviors.
Check both the returned order and the original list.
off_by_one: A sorted result should contain every original item.
Compare the lengths before comparing the order.
Trace a two-item list and a list with repeated values.
unhandled_short_input: An empty list already has a sorted order.
A one-item list needs no special missing position.
Avoid assuming there are two values to compare.
Trace empty, one-item, and two-item inputs.

explanations.empty_list: An empty list has an empty sorted copy.
explanations.short_input: Short lists can be sorted without indexing beyond their contents.
explanations.exact_boundary: The result must preserve every item at the boundary case.
explanations.normal: Return ascending values while leaving the input unchanged.
